note: The growth step of the hourly tick (docs 10, 11). habitat: how the 1 m habitat grid is built from the water summary: moisture falls from fresh water to nothing over bankM; the tide band holds at least bandMoisture and bandSalt (0..255); salt falls from the sea and band over saltM. grass: painting decides where grass is at once; the grass cover per cell (how well grass likes the ground) follows the ground slowly, moving toward its target by ratePerH of the gap each game hour, so a dug pond drowns its grass over about a day and drained ground greens again; grass thins in standing water and on salty ground (saltFrom: thinning starts, saltFull: none from this salt up), and gives way where rushes stand: its target falls by yieldToCover times the rushes' share; grass.habitat: the ground axes grass asks for, as in reeds.json (earth rather than sand or rock, no steeper than about 35 degrees). maxPlants caps the individual plants on the island. starters: the species a new island starts with (with grass). Every other species, plant or cover, arrives later by itself as a volunteer (src/world/growth/volunteers.js): volunteers.order is the order they come in (one the island has no ground for yet is skipped until it has), none in the island's first firstAfterH game hours, at least gapH hours between two, then a chance of chancePerH each hour; it lands, as a sprout or a new tussock, on a square it likes at least minSuit. The journal notes the first one and the Plant tool offers it from then on. species: the flora recipes that grow (recipes/flora/<id>.json); the four tea herbs come in volunteers.order like the rest: water mint after iris and chamomile after marigold (Matt, October 24, 2026), marram (a fibre plant) after gorse, meadowsweet and nettle last, nettle only once its cause is met (recipes/flora/nettle.json volunteer.cause); testSets: the species a `?plants=<set>` test link adds to the starters (`?plants=herbs`, `?plants=fibres`), as `?plants=all` adds every species; pondweed is in neither starters nor volunteers: it comes only as the minnows' gift of seed. cover: cover plants other than grass (recipes/flora/<id>.json, layer cover): each keeps a share per square meter that moves toward how well it likes the ground, like the grass cover. marks: the Plant tool's rings on the ground (UI only): each planted seed gets a ring that grows from tapRadiusM[0] to [1] and fades over tapS seconds; while the tool is open, the player's plantings that are not yet mature carry a youngRadiusM ring at youngOpacity (at most 15, the newest first). A living thing tapped with no tool chosen (the journal's card) gets a ring that blooms in over selectBloomS seconds, then breathes: its radius swells by selectPulse and its opacity moves between selectOpacity over selectPulseS seconds; the ring's size comes from recipes/world/journal.json identify.ringM. gather (docs/future/13 5.2, src/world/growth/rules.js): plants whose flora recipe is tagged gather share one island budget; once that many stand, their spread and volunteers fail quietly (hand plantings and undo may pass it); they never spread or volunteer onto held ground: under a placed piece, on the camp pad, where rushes stand at rushBlock of full cover or more, or within clearM of any other plant. bury (src/world/growth/bury.js, the bush rule of October 24: ride up whole or go under whole): a plant stands on its seat, the ground under its base ring (its clump or cushion radius by its size) read at its middle and seatPoints round it, raised to the ring's highest point less seatSlack times the radius, so a raise lapping one side lifts it and no plant shows half in the ground. When a stroke settles, a plant whose seat rose more than raiseM (plus heightShare of its drawn height when it is drawn taller than tallM) goes under whole and rides in the undo (recordBytes each); undo brings it back exactly. strokeNotice and sessionNotice: gather plants under one stroke, or in one session, before the island says so. While a raising brush is out, every plant it would cover shows a soft ring: within the brush radius plus ringM, at most rings of them, nearest first, at ringOpacity, each ringRadiusM across or its base ring plus 0.25 m if larger. looks (docs/future/13 5.6; src/world/growth/looks.js, lib-flora.wgsl): how a plant shows what happened to it, worked out from its record each upload and never saved. picked is how far below its best a pick left it (one full pick is 1): pickHeads of its flower heads go at one full pick, pickTrim of a share of its blade and leaf tips is cut back, and from cutFrom picked on, cutBlades cut blades lie at its foot (thrift and iris). thin ramps up over thinRampH hours once poor ground has outlasted the plant's lowHours: thinPale paler, thinSparse of its blades and leaves gone, no new heads. drowned is its drown counter over its drown hours: blades and stems lean drownLean of the way to the ground, darken by drownDark, and flower stalks droop by drownDroop of their height.
